title: Chapter 1375 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy
content:
Chapter 1375 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy

Chapter 1375: Chapter 3: You Have the Gray Ancestor, I Have the Galaxy

When it comes to the level of time life, actually making a move to kill is a rarity.

For instance, in this skirmish between the Chaos Void and the Tai Xu Dimension, the strongest on both sides have not made a move.

Instead, the focus is on observing more future timelines until a favorable timeline is found.

Lord Mo Xu and the Master of Taixu are unlikely to engage in much confrontation.

The time lives of both dimensions won’t genuinely strive for a life-or-death battle either.

This pertains to the First Realm of time life.

As for the Second Realm of time life? Their plotting is even more silent and stealthy.

Even if they lay out plans, they promote them from behind the scenes.

The time lives of the Second Realm see timelines that are deeper and more numerous.

If they deliberately conceal their existence, First Realm time lives will struggle to notice anything.

Of course, nothing is absolute.

If a Second Realm time life intervenes excessively, seeking too much.

The traces left behind will become complex.

There is still the possibility that a First Realm time life could detect some anomalies.

Especially as the future approaches a certain specific point in time.

The probability of being detected will increase.

Only this time behind the Tai Xu Dimension is a Second Realm time life known as ’Gray Ancestor’.

Merely scheming for that Heart of Heavenly River without much killing intent towards the seven time lives of Chaos Void.

The extent of interference is also not significant.

Even under normal circumstances, the ’Gray Ancestor’ has no intention of making a personal move.

Therefore, until now, Lord Mo Xu and the other seven time lives haven’t noticed anything unusual.

"What?"

"Is there a Second Realm time life promoting from behind the scenes?"

Lord Mo Xu and the other time lives couldn’t help but change their expressions.

Second Realm time life?

In this vast dimensional gap, there are only two Second Realm time lives.

Both are pursuing the path of the lord; meddling with the Milky Way Dimension? It’s practically impossible.

"No wonder the future timelines I’ve been seeing lately are much more obscure than usual; I thought it involved multiple time lives of the Tai Xu Dimension."

Lord Mo Xu pondered thoughtfully.

He did not doubt what Lin Yuan said.

He believed it the moment he heard it.

In fact, he had vaguely sensed something wasn’t right even before.

But he hadn’t attributed it to a Second Realm time life.

Firstly, because Second Realm time lives are so rare.

Secondly, the Heart of Heavenly River doesn’t attract a Second Realm time life to make a special move.

"That explains why those guys from the Tai Xu Dimension are so desperate."

Many doubts in the hearts of the other time lives were also explained.

"Galaxy, why is a Second Realm time life promoting from behind the scenes?"

The time life with a human head and snake body asked in a low voice.

He is called ’Zhu Yin’, the first life nurtured by the Chaos Void.

Similar to the ’Abyss Dragon’ of the first origin world.

But in terms of strength at the twelfth level, ’Zhu Yin’ was not as strong as ’Abyss Dragon’.

But in the end, the ’Abyss Dragon’ did not cross into the thirteenth level, while ’Zhu Yin’ successfully became a time life.

"Yes, the Second Realm time life, what are they scheming?"

Lord Mo Xu was also somewhat puzzled.

Time life is divided into three levels.

First Realm, Second Realm, Third Realm.

The pursuit of each level of time life is different too.

What the First Realm time life seeks, the Second Realm time life basically does not value.

The Heart of Heavenly River nurtured by the Milky Way Dimension is not much use to Second Realm time life.

Directly experiencing the origin operation of the Milky Way Dimension? In such a non-intrusive special dimensional space as the Milky Way Dimension, a Second Realm time life would like to observe its origin operation.

Without needing to especially rely on the Heart of Heavenly River.

"This time, the Heart of Heavenly River nurtured is very special."

Lin Yuan explained briefly.

With the aid of a lord’s status, the depth of timelines he sees is only weaker than Gray Ancestor’s, naturally discovering the potential of this Heart of Heavenly River.

"I see."

Lord Mo Xu nodded slightly.

He hadn’t thought too much about the Heart of Heavenly River.

He just assumed it was similar to the Hearts of Heavenly River previously nurtured.

"Then how should we respond to the Tai Xu Dimension now?"

Zhu Yin looked at the time lives, solemnly speaking.

As these words were spoken.

The surroundings fell into silence.

Lord Mo Xu also hesitated.

Honestly, if they didn’t know a Second Realm time life was pushing from the shadows.

They’d be confident in fighting, at least not to disgrace themselves.

But now that they know about a Second Realm time life’s involvement, Lord Mo Xu and the other time lives were somewhat hesitant.

A First Realm time life has trouble competing with a Second Realm time life.

It’s not just a matter of power differential; it’s also about future timeline grasp.

If Lin Yuan hadn’t reminded them this time, the seven time lives might not even have noticed ’Gray Ancestor’’s existence.

Ultimately watching the Heart of Heavenly River being taken away in confusion, not knowing the full truth, only feeling inferior.

A First Realm time life wanting to contend with a Second Realm time life is exceedingly difficult.

Rely solely on viewing time online, and a Second Realm time life holds absolute initiative.

Lord Mo Xu and several other time lives exchanged glances, immediately considering a retreat.

Because under the push of a Second Realm time life, they have no hope of capturing the Heart of Heavenly River.

The more they invest, the more they ultimately lose.

Instead of this, it is better to directly give up.

After all, losing to a Second Realm time life is not shameful.

"Is a Second Realm time life that difficult to deal with?"

The newly ascended time life Luo Hou sensed the oppressive atmosphere, couldn’t help but ask.

He also knew about the matters of the Milky Way Dimension, even Lord Mo Xu asked him to stabilize his thirteenth-level realm before going to the Milky Way Dimension to assist.
